milestone: 0.5.0 development: Quick Settings category keyboard navigation and narrow layouts

reference.source: iina/SideBar.swift: NSSegmentedControl owns category selection; SidebarTabViewController owns page transitions
reference.windows_equivalent: One category Tab stop; Left/Right select adjacent categories; Home/End select endpoints. Native macOS key behavior has not been observed in this batch.

baseline_observation: Native light Audio category retained focus on Left but displayed a playback seek OSD instead of selecting Video.
implementation: Category group keeps selection and keyboard focus together, clamps arrows at either end, exposes selected accessibility state and leaves the group on Tab.
Layout content keeps a 300 logical pixel minimum scroll extent below normal sidebar width; cards derive from content width rather than the clipped viewport.
The numeric editor key guard is excluded from Tab traversal; Layout switches and audio/video track rows display focus outlines.

widget_regressions.backend: Slint 1.18.1 headless; actual generated PlayerWindow widgets
scope: Seven existing numeric edit lifecycle regressions retained
Category Left/Right/Home/End and endpoint clamping preserve focus and do not invoke playback bindings
One Tab leaves the category group for the page
Category buttons remain in bounds without overlapping Close on both sides at 285/320/440/960 logical pixels, in both spacing modes
Tab from delay slider enters editor directly
Shift+Tab commits the draft once and returns to the delay slider

observations: Left selected Video from Audio; End selected Subtitles; Home selected Layout with the focus outline following selection.
At the minimum video client size the category header retained all four icons and the close control.
Tab from Layout entered Dark, Light, Auto in order; the scroll view revealed Light and Auto horizontally.
Tab through Audio entered both track rows, external audio, delay slider and delay editor; the page scrolled vertically to reveal each.
bugs_found_and_corrected_after_this_buil: The numeric key-guard FocusScope added an invisible Tab stop before the editor.
Layout switches and audio/video track rows lacked a focus outline.
manual_gui.input_caveat: After Alt+Space system-menu interaction, arrows acted as Alt-modified frame steps. A separate Alt press/release cleared that state before the category checks. No native modifier-routing change is included.

observations: One Tab from the delay slider selected the editor text directly. Typing 0.65 then Shift+Tab applied the observed delay and visibly focused the slider.
The audio track row displayed its focus outline.
At 285 by 160 logical client pixels Layout retained all category icons and Close; its horizontal scrollbar was visible.
manual_gui.shutdown: Normal Alt+F4; no Riina process before the next launch

observations: Tab passed the category group and Close into Dark, Light, Auto and On Screen Display. The display switch had a visible focus outline; Space toggled it.
At 285 by 160 logical client pixels all four categories and Close remained visible. End selected Subtitles, Home selected Layout and Right selected Video; the outline followed selection.
The video track row displayed its focus outline in the narrow sidebar.
manual_gui.shutdown: Normal Alt+F4; no Riina process before the playback smoke
